properties.name: authz.config-location
properties.description: Location of the authorization.yaml configuration file.

properties.name: authz.user-issuer
properties.description: Auth Service issuer URL for user JWT validation (REQUIRED).

properties.name: authz.user-jwks-uri
properties.description: Auth Service JWKS URI for user JWT validation (REQUIRED).

properties.name: authz.service-issuer
properties.description: SSO/OIDC issuer URL for service token validation (REQUIRED).

properties.name: authz.service-jwks-uri
properties.description: SSO/OIDC JWKS URI for service token validation (REQUIRED).

properties.name: authz.audience
properties.description: Expected audience for user JWTs. REQUIRED - must be a non-blank string.

properties.name: authz.service-token-use-claim
properties.description: Claim name that marks a service token.

properties.name: authz.service-token-use-value
properties.description: Expected value of the service-token-use claim.

properties.name: authz.clock-skew-seconds
properties.description: Clock skew tolerance (seconds) for JWT exp/nbf checks.

properties.name: authz.role-service-url
properties.description: Authoritative Role Service base URL (REQUIRED).

properties.name: authz.role-service-connect-timeout-ms
properties.description: Role Service HTTP connect timeout in milliseconds.

properties.name: authz.role-service-read-timeout-ms
properties.description: Role Service HTTP read timeout in milliseconds.

properties.name: authz.disk-cache-path
properties.description: Fallback/seed cache file path.

properties.name: authz.kafka-brokers
properties.description: Kafka brokers for incremental role events (empty list disables Kafka).

properties.name: authz.role-updates-topic
properties.description: Kafka topic for role UPSERT events.

properties.name: authz.role-delete-topic
properties.description: Kafka topic for role DELETE events.

properties.name: authz.publish-roles-topic
properties.description: Kafka topic that triggers a forced full re-fetch.

properties.name: authz.kafka-group-id
properties.description: Kafka consumer group prefix. A UUID is appended per instance.

properties.name: authz.kafka-client-id
properties.description: Kafka consumer client ID.

properties.name: authz.reconcile-interval-ms
properties.description: Reconciler interval in milliseconds.

properties.name: authz.token-url
properties.description: OAuth2 token endpoint URL for outbound service identity.

properties.name: authz.client-id
properties.description: OAuth2 client ID for outbound service identity.

properties.name: authz.client-secret
properties.description: OAuth2 client secret for outbound service identity.

properties.name: authz.token-endpoint-timeout-ms
properties.description: Token endpoint HTTP timeout in milliseconds.

properties.name: authz.untrusted-header-prefixes
properties.description: Additional untrusted header name prefixes (lower-cased) to strip from inbound requests.

properties.name: authz.untrusted-header-exact
properties.description: Additional untrusted exact header names (lower-cased) to strip from inbound requests.
